pages.title: An Open Table
pages.text: Corral bars enclose the working trough and chicken feed points toward the poultry branch.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Craft the Feeding Trough using its shown recipe. Stock food the chosen animal accepts and let one animal approach and eat. No mass breeding is needed.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place the trough and stock the breeding food appropriate to nearby tempted animals. Animals approach, eat and enter breeding behavior without individual hand feeding.
